w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Gavel, Big Big, Nostalgia, Old Stare) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Terms of Service is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Olivia telling the fire about Ethan. "Ethan came back mauled by The Callback (9 rounds, 50 taken) and alive. Three white lines across the forearm now." The story's already growing.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Ethan. Buffering, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ad Break is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1316 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/13/9), with 4 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 20 · Craft 10 · Talk 16 · Explore 40 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Desmond Clarke ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Ethan returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,091 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
